shots.action: The subject ages fifty years in a few seconds: hair fades to grey, wrinkles deepen around the eyes and mouth, while they hold a calm gaze toward the lens.
shots.sound: A ticking clock slowing down under a gentle string swell.

end.paint: Age the person by fifty years: grey hair, deep wrinkles, age spots and softer skin, same clothes. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.
